summary: Evogene Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its subsidiary AgPlenus Ltd. and Bayer have discontinued their herbicide development project, effective May 18, 2026. The termination was triggered by the target protein not meeting required product criteria. Under the termination terms, all assets licensed to Bayer under the collaboration, including the APTH1 protein target and associated active molecules, revert to AgPlenus. This is a deal termination between AgPlenus and Bayer; no financial terms, premium, or break fee were disclosed. The reversion of IP rights is noted. This UK-equivalent Form 6-K is incorporated by reference into Evogene's F-3 and S-8 registration statements. Watch for any potential new partnering or licensing activities by AgPlenus.
